ContactPage.title: Let's start a conversation
ContactPage.description: Two ways to start working together: direct contact or a freelance platform.
ContactPage.hireChannelsDescription: The website stays the canonical source either way — a platform profile only ever links back here.

ContactPage.consultationNote: Prefer to talk first? Book a free intro call — you offer the times, I confirm one.

StartPage.title: Let’s scope the project
StartPage.description: A short, structured brief. A few minutes now means less back-and-forth later. Answer what you know and skip what you don’t.

BriefBuilder.serviceStepDescription: Pick the closest match — this only helps me prepare, it doesn't lock you in.
BriefBuilder.goalLabel: What outcome are you trying to reach?

BriefBuilder.scopeStepTitle: What does it need to do?

BriefBuilder.budgetHint: A rough range only — this helps me suggest the right engagement model, not a fixed quote.
BriefBuilder.linksStepDescription: A current site, a competitor, a design reference — anything that helps me understand the project. Optional.

BriefBuilder.consentLabel: I agree that Artaveo may contact me about this project using the details above.

BriefBuilder.rateLimitedDescription: Please wait a moment before trying again.
BriefBuilder.notLiveDescription: The Brief Builder backend is built, but it is not connected to a live database yet. Your answers are not saved on this site. Send the brief by email instead, and I'll reply directly.
BriefBuilder.genericErrorDescription: Your brief wasn't saved due to an unexpected error. Nothing was lost — send it by email instead and I'll reply directly; your answers above are already in the message.
BriefBuilder.successDescription: Thanks — I'll reply with next steps.
BriefBuilder.offlineQueuedDescription: Your brief is saved on this device and will send automatically the moment you're back online — you don't need to do anything else. You can also go back and keep editing while you wait.

Admin.notifIntro: Every e-mail the site produces is saved here before it is sent, so a provider outage never loses one. Failed messages are retried with growing delays; the ones that keep failing wait here for you.
Admin.notifNotConfigured: The notification log is not configured yet — no database connection is set up.
Admin.notifProviderConsoleOff: Real sending is off. Messages are recorded as “sent” by the console provider, but nothing leaves the server until a real provider is set up.
Admin.notifProviderMisconfigured: EMAIL_PROVIDER is set to “{requested}”, but the provider is not fully configured, so nothing is being delivered. Check RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.
Admin.notifCronSecretMissing: CRON_SECRET is not set in this deployment, so the daily run — retries and scheduled publishing — is refused. Add it in the Vercel project settings and redeploy.
Admin.notifUncoveredInquiries: {count, plural, one {# inquiry from the last 7 days has} other {# inquiries from the last 7 days have}} no notification record. The inquiry itself is saved.
Admin.notifExhaustedBanner: {count, plural, one {# message failed for good and needs you.} other {# messages failed for good and need you.}}
Admin.notifOverdue: {count, plural, one {# message is} other {# messages are}} due and waiting for a sweep — the oldest since {date}.
Admin.notifNoOverdue: Nothing is waiting: every message that is due has been attempted.
Admin.notifEmptyDescription: Clear a filter, or come back after the next inquiry or submission.
Admin.notifRetryResultFailed: Still failing — it will be tried again later. See the error on the message.
Admin.notifRetryResultExhausted: Failed again and stopped. See the error on the message.
Admin.notifErrorNotRetryable: This message can’t be retried in its current state.
Admin.notifDetailExhausted: This message failed for good and will not be retried on its own. Fix the cause shown below, then press Retry now.
Admin.notifNotDeliveredNote: The console provider only logged this message — no e-mail was sent.
Admin.notifAttemptsEmpty: No attempt has been made yet.
Admin.cmsRecRequestEmailNote: With an address, the site e-mails them this link — and, if you later ask for a change, that request too. The address is deleted as soon as the request is finished (revoked, approved, rejected, or expired unused).

Admin.cmsRecEmailQueued: Link created and queued for e-mail. Check the state below.
Admin.cmsRecEmailQueueFailed: Link created, but the e-mail could not be queued. Copy the link and send it yourself.
Admin.cmsRecEmailNotQueued: e-mail was not queued — copy the link

Admin.obsIntro: What is wrong, what happened and how often. Errors and business events are kept here for 90 days, because the hosting log lasts about an hour. Every record carries a request reference that leads to the log line, the lead and the e-mails of the same request.
Admin.obsUnreadable: The overview could not be read from the database. That is itself a finding: check that the database is reachable and that migration 0021 is applied.
Admin.obsRefHint: A request reference is a long identifier (from a log line, a lead or an e-mail). An error number is the short code on a visitor’s error page.
Admin.obsRefInvalid: That is neither a request reference nor an error number.
Admin.obsRefNothing: Nothing is stored under that reference. Log lines last about an hour on the hosting plan, so an older request may only exist in the records below.
Admin.obsRefLogHint: To read the log lines of this request, search the hosting log for the reference.
Admin.obsAlertsFootnote: Alerts are recalculated every time this page opens and clear on their own once the cause is fixed. Errors are also e-mailed, at most once a day per problem, and make the external check fail.
Admin.obsAlertNotificationsUncovered: An inquiry arrived and no e-mail was queued for it
Admin.obsAlertNotificationsUncoveredAction: Open Leads and read the newest briefs, then check Notifications.
Admin.obsAlertNotificationsFailingAction: Open Notifications, read the last error of a failed message, fix the cause (provider, key, sender domain) and press Retry.
Admin.obsAlertNotificationsStuck: Messages have been waiting for more than a day
Admin.obsAlertNotificationsStuckAction: Open Notifications and press “Send due messages now”. If they stay, read the last error.
Admin.obsAlertErrorsSpikeAction: Find the group with the highest count below and use its reference to read the log line.
Admin.obsAlertErrorsNew: New errors in the last day
Admin.obsAlertErrorsNewAction: Read the newest groups below. Mark each resolved or ignored once you understand it.
Admin.obsAlertAuditWriteFailed: The audit log is missing entries
Admin.obsAlertAuditWriteFailedAction: Check that the database is reachable and migration 0008 is applied. The log lines named audit.write_failed carry the cause.
Admin.obsAlertRateLimitUnavailable: The rate limiter is not answering
Admin.obsAlertRateLimitUnavailableAction: Requests are allowed without being counted (it fails open by design). Check the database and that migration 0020 is applied.
Admin.obsAlertCronStale: The daily run has not completed
Admin.obsAlertCronStaleAction: Check that CRON_SECRET is set in Vercel (16 characters or more) and that the current deployment is live. See the notifications runbook.
Admin.obsAlertMonitorSilent: The external check has stopped checking in
Admin.obsAlertMonitorSilentAction: Open the repository’s Actions tab. GitHub switches scheduled workflows off after 60 days without repository activity; re-enable it there.
Admin.obsAlertConfigInvalid: The deployment is missing required settings
Admin.obsAlertConfigInvalidAction: Set the named variables in the Vercel project settings and redeploy (docs/security.md, section 6).
Admin.obsAlertAuthSignInPressure: The sign-in limit was crossed more than once today
Admin.obsAlertAuthSignInPressureAction: If it was not you, enable MFA at Security and consider Vercel’s Attack Challenge Mode.
Admin.obsAlertBackupFailingAction: Open the “Backup” workflow in the repository’s Actions tab, read the failed step, and re-run it; the backup runbook has the recovery steps if it keeps failing.
Admin.obsAlertBackupStaleAction: Check that the “Backup” workflow is scheduled and enabled in the repository’s Actions tab (GitHub disables a schedule after 60 days with no repository activity).
Admin.obsAlertBackupRestoreFailedAction: Open the “Backup” workflow’s restore-test job and read the failed step; the backup runbook has the manual procedure to try in the meantime.
Admin.obsAlertBackupRestoreStale: No restore has been verified recently
Admin.obsAlertBackupRestoreStaleAction: Open the “Backup” workflow in the repository’s Actions tab and check that its weekly restore-test job is running.
Admin.obsHealthMonitorHint: No external check has called the site yet. Add the CRON_SECRET secret and the SITE_URL variable to the GitHub repository so the scheduled uptime workflow can run (docs/observability.md, section 5).
Admin.obsHealthEmailLogOnly: Log only — nothing leaves the server
Admin.obsHealthBackupHint: No backup has completed yet. Add the BACKUP_AGE_PUBLIC_KEY variable and the SUPABASE_DB_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY secrets to the GitHub repository so the scheduled backup workflow can run (docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md).
Admin.obsHealthRestoreTestHint: No restore has been tested yet. It runs weekly inside the same “Backup” workflow, once a backup exists.
Admin.obsFunnelFootnote: Counted from the events recorded since event tracking was switched on; earlier activity is not in these numbers.
Admin.obsGroupsEmptyDescription: Errors from pages, actions, background runs and browsers appear here, grouped by what went wrong.
Admin.obsEventsEmptyDescription: Inquiries, published content, failed messages and daily runs are listed here as they happen.

ConsultationPage.title: Book a free intro call
ConsultationPage.description: A short call to talk through your project and see whether we're a good fit. Offer a few times that suit you, and I'll confirm one.
ConsultationPage.expect1: A free call of up to 30 minutes — enough for me to understand the project and for us to see whether I'm the right person for it.
ConsultationPage.expect2: You offer up to three time ranges in your own time zone. I pick a time inside one of them, or suggest another.
ConsultationPage.expect3: You get the confirmation with a calendar invitation, and a private link to change the time or cancel.
ConsultationPage.expect4: Nothing is booked until I confirm a time. My commitment: replies within a few hours, same day.
ConsultationPage.briefNote: Would you rather describe the project in detail first? The Brief Builder is the better start.
ConsultationPage.fieldPhoneHint: Add it if you'd like the call on WhatsApp.
ConsultationPage.fieldGoal: What would you like to talk about?
ConsultationPage.timesHint: Offer one to three time ranges. Each must last at least {minutes} minutes and start between {hours} hours and {days} days from now.
ConsultationPage.consentLabel: I agree that Artaveo stores these details to reply to my request, as described in the privacy policy.
ConsultationPage.errorGoalShort: Tell me a little more — at least {min} characters.
ConsultationPage.errorConsent: Consent is required to send this.
ConsultationPage.errorWindowIncomplete: Choose a date and both times.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-count: Offer between one and three times.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-invalid: Check the date and the times.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-order: The end has to be after the start.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-too-short: Each time range must last at least {minutes} minutes.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-too-long: A time range can last at most {hours} hours.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-too-soon: A time range must start at least {hours} hours from now.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-too-far: A time range must start within {days} days.
ConsultationPage.errorWindow_window-nonexistent: That clock time doesn't exist in your time zone (clocks change that day).
ConsultationPage.errorRejected: Something about this request couldn't be accepted — please check the form and try again in a little while.
ConsultationPage.errorNotConfigured: This form isn't available right now — please try again later.
ConsultationPage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong — please try again.
ConsultationPage.errorNetwork: The request didn't go through. Check your connection and try again — nothing was sent.
ConsultationPage.errorOffline: You're offline. Reconnect and send it again — nothing was sent.
ConsultationPage.successDescription: I'll reply with a confirmed time — replies within a few hours, same day. Keep the private link below: it always shows the current status, and lets you change the time or cancel.

ConsultationManage.descRequested: I haven't confirmed a time yet — replies come within a few hours, same day. Nothing is booked until I do.
ConsultationManage.descConfirmed: Your call is booked. The details are below.
ConsultationManage.descRescheduled: You've asked for a different time. The time below still stands until I confirm a new one.
ConsultationManage.descCompleted: This call took place. Thanks for talking.
ConsultationManage.changeHint: This replaces the times above with new ones. {left, plural, one {You can do this once more.} other {You can do this # more times.}}
ConsultationManage.changeLimit: You've used all your changes. E-mail {email} instead.
ConsultationManage.changeSuccess: Sent — I'll confirm one of the new times.
ConsultationManage.cancelHint: You can always request a new call afterwards.
ConsultationManage.errorNotAllowed: This call can't be changed any more — reload the page to see where it stands.
ConsultationManage.errorNotFound: This link is no longer valid.
ConsultationManage.errorNotConfigured: This isn't available right now — please try again later.
ConsultationManage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong — please try again.
ConsultationManage.errorNetwork: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
ConsultationManage.invalidDescription: This link doesn't exist. If you were expecting it, check the address in your e-mail — or request a new call.
ConsultationManage.expiredDescription: This call ended a while ago, so its page is closed. You can request a new call any time.

BlockHints.intro: A few sentences that introduce the project, at the top of its page.

BlockHints.gallery: Screens with one-line captions. Pick them from this project's images or upload new ones.
BlockHints.features-by-role: What each kind of user can do — for example passenger, office staff, manager.
BlockHints.audience: Who the software is for — the kinds of businesses or people.
BlockHints.result: What changed for the customer. Only what is true.
BlockHints.faq: Questions a customer asks before buying or starting, with their answers.
BlockHints.video: A YouTube or Vimeo video of the project, shown in the page.
